name: 事项
description: 官方插件:待办 / 日程 / 定时任务 —— 没有时间的是待办,有时间的是日程,有时间+重复+动作的是定时任务

tools.name: item_add
tools.description: Add an item to the user's planner. Use it whenever the user asks to remember, schedule or be reminded of something — a task, a meeting, a deadline. Pass `when` for anything with a time, `repeat` for anything recurring, `remindBefore` to notify ahead of time, and `onDue` when the agent itself should do something at that moment. An item with no `when` is a plain to-do with no time at all.

title.description: Short title of the thing to do

when.description: When it happens. Prefer an explicit form like 2026-09-30 14:00 or 2026-09-30; free text such as 明天下午3点 or 后天 is also accepted and is echoed back for confirmation. Omit entirely for a plain to-do with no time.

end.description: Optional end time, same formats as `when`

repeat.description: How it repeats: daily / weekly / monthly / yearly, or a raw RRULE body such as FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO. Requires `when`.

remindBefore.description: Minutes before it starts to send a desktop notification, e.g. 15. Requires `when`.

onDue.description: A message to send to you (the agent) at that moment — e.g. '总结昨天的提交'. Requires `when`. The user must confirm this, so only set it when they asked for it.

tools.name: item_list
tools.description: List the user's items with their times, repeat rules, completion state and next firing time.

range.description: Which window to list. Defaults to week.

tools.name: item_update
tools.description: Change an existing item. Finds it by title substring. Only the fields you pass are changed.

title.description: Title (or part of it) of the item to change

when.description: New time, same formats as in item_add. Pass an empty string to remove the time.

repeat.description: New repeat rule, or an empty string to stop repeating

done.description: Mark the current occurrence done or not done

tools.name: item_remove
tools.description: Delete an item by title substring. Prefer marking it done unless the user asked to delete it.

title.description: Title (or part of it) of the item to delete
